name: NURS 5269
title: Advanced Theory and Practice in Nursing Education II: Assessment and Evaluation Strategies Practicum
description: This course will help students apply important concepts, principles, and practices related to assessment and evaluation in the selected practicum setting. The appropriate identification, selection, and development of evaluation strategies according to context, learning domain, and level of cognition is emphasized.
requirement_description: NURS 5250, NURS 5259. Instructor consent required. Corequisite: NURS 5260.
